description: The FortiGate-VM appliances are software modules designed to execute on a General Purpose Computer (GPC) hardware platform running the VMware hypervisor and FortiOS 5.4. The FortiOS provides integrated firewall, VPN, antivirus, antispam, intrusion prevention, content filtering and traffic shaping and HA capabilities.
tested_configurations: FortiGate-VM on FortiHypervisor v1.1.0,build 0129 (single-user mode) running on FortiHypervisor-500D with Intel Xeon E3 processor with the Fortinet entropy token (part number FTR-ENT-1 or FTR-ENT-2)
